summary: Pulp worker and content service KPIs are high sync rates, frequent EE or collection uploads and downloads, disk I/O waits on /var/lib/pulp, and Pulp CPU saturation or queuing; scale with hub.content.replicas and hub.worker.replicas on the AnsibleAutomationPlatform CR, or add hub nodes on VM and container installs.
questions: How do I scale automation hub Pulp workers?
How do I speed up automation hub content syncs?

answer_card.title: Scale automation hub services
answer_card.answer_md:
| Service | OpenShift (`AnsibleAutomationPlatform` CR) |
|---|---|
| API | `hub.api.replicas` |
| Content | `hub.content.replicas` |
| Pulp workers | `hub.worker.replicas` |

Watch for high `/api/galaxy` latency, heavy sync or EE pull rates, disk I/O wait on `/var/lib/pulp`, and Pulp CPU saturation. On VM-based or containerized installs, add automation hub nodes, which scales all hub services together.
